beats.headline: The one box not for Donut
beats.text: Mordecai has never seen anything like it. Five items sit on the table, all from Apothecary sponsorship boxes, all given to different crawlers, all with notes saying they should go to Donut, and that is not counting Carl's Pawna's Cries or Prepotente's I Take It All Back, both meant for her too. Of everyone the Apothecary sponsors, only Katia got a box not meant for Donut: a small knit beanie, three percent to all her stats down the line, and a spell called I Need My Personal Space. It violently knocks everybody back, party members included. She puts it on, and it sinks into her mass and disappears.

beats.headline: Off her head, onto his
beats.text: Katia has to go back and help against Imogen, and Carl has already spent his Protective Shell. A fifteen-foot mountain of bugs, some still alive, stands between him and the deity hiding in the corner. Katia pulls the beanie off her head and puts it on his, where it equips itself with a little beep: use the spell to clear through the nymphs, get Donut close enough. At the top of the hill a group of bugs lunges at him. He casts I Need My Personal Space, and it pushes them all in different directions, like a miniature Protective Shell. Mongo and Donut jump in, and they land before the god.
